deploy_pipeline: mlx_lm.fuse (4-bit → FP16) → convert_hf_to_gguf q8_0 → ollama create
qualitative_observation: MLX-direct A/B (earlier): LoRA reliably cites user habits (e.g. 'serde rename', '动态阻尼机制'); overlap +23% vs base. Ollama-deployed via GGUF: generation quality degraded — outputs drift into off-topic stories / multiple-choice patterns, no reliable habit citations. Cause: 4-bit→FP16→q8_0 quantization roundtrip loses adapter signal. This is a known MLX+GGUF tradeoff, not a bug. Use MLX direct when possible, Ollama for deployment where cross-platform matters more than fidelity.
recommended_mitigations: Keep MLX-native serving for best quality (mlx_lm.server)
If GGUF needed, use f16/bf16 outtype instead of q8_0 to reduce loss
Use larger base model (3B+) where LoRA rank effect is less fragile
Train more iters on larger dataset — 82 examples is at the lower bound
